menagerie.local_clone: third_party/mujoco_menagerie (gitignored; clone and check out the pinned commit to reproduce)

assets: franka_emika_panda/panda.xml (arm + hand) at the pinned Menagerie commit
franka_emika_panda/assets/ (meshes and textures) via the scene/assets junction - see setup_notes
setup_notes: Create a junction (Windows) or symlink (POSIX) at scene/assets pointing to third_party/mujoco_menagerie/franka_emika_panda/assets. MuJoCo resolves the included model's meshdir ('assets') relative to the root MJCF folder (scene/), not the included file's folder.

seeds.determinism_check: fixed Panda home keyframe (nkey=1); no perturbation seeds at Gate 1
seeds.gate2_battery: perturbation seeds are defined with the Gate 2 battery (5 positions x 4 draws)
